## Goal
Apply preparing target validation at the pre-execution dispatcher boundary and align prelude routing, arguments, and help metadata.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2 dispatcher mismatches return before module loading, hooks, agents, mutation, or worktree creation.
- R3 and R4 command registry and help contracts are coherent for all five prelude commands.
- R5 active post-prepare guard behavior and guard-free behavior remain unchanged.

## Implementation Notes
Limit production changes to `dispatcher.js` and `registry.js`. Use existing `withTargetGuardOptions` and shared target-state selection instead of command-local validation.

## Test Strategy
Extend dispatcher and registry/help tests, plus focused command E2E coverage for request, note, auto-check, and prepare side-effect ordering.
